name: The Supreme Magister

angles.text: Elaadrin notes a vibrant arcane aura around practitioners of magic, valuing the rare aptitude and will required to master the arcane and preserve their homeland.

faq.answer: Elaadrin Evengale is the current Supreme Magister of the High Order. He oversees their operations from a lodge situated in the southeastern corner of Valanaar, searching for individuals with the arcane aptitude and resolve to protect their home.
Elaadrin Evengale and his followers operate out of a lodge located in the far southeastern area of Valanaar.
faq.q: Where can Elaadrin Evengale be found?

faq.answer: The High Order is an arcane organization operating within Valanaar under Supreme Magister Elaadrin Evengale. They focus on wielding arcane power to defend their home, despite dwindling numbers and rising local tensions.

aliases: why do high order and windshapers fight
faq.answer: The High Order and the Windshapers harbor an intense rivalry in Valanaar. Local leadership insists on keeping a wide berth between them to prevent open faction violence in the streets, especially with cult activity threatening the settlement.
faq.q: Why is there conflict between the High Order and the Windshapers?

faq.answer: Rathiril is an associate or member who directs promising adventurers to the High Order in Valanaar via magical missives, alerting Elaadrin Evengale to individuals with notable potential.

A mysterious cult is active around Valanaar, presenting enough of a danger that local authorities actively suppress infighting between groups like the High Order and the Windshapers to keep the settlement secure.

sections.body: Upon arriving in Valanaar, newcomers of notable promise are directed toward the High Order. Led by Supreme Magister Elaadrin Evengale, the organization operates from a lodge in the far southeastern reaches of the settlement. Elaadrin monitors new arrivals closely, seeking those possessing the strength, resolve, and arcane aura necessary to confront the perils surrounding their endangered home.
sections.title: The High Order of Valanaar

sections.body: Valanaar suffers from fragile internal peace. The High Order and the Windshapers share deep hostility, prompting warnings for newcomers to give the Windshapers a wide berth to prevent violence erupting in the streets. With a dangerous cult lurking nearby, local leaders cannot afford internal bloodshed while external threats loom over the town.
sections.title: Rival Factions and Looming Cults

summary: The Supreme Magister directs newly arrived adventurers in Valanaar to Elaadrin Evengale, leader of the High Order. Operating from a lodge in the southeastern part of the settlement, the order seeks capable allies while navigating bitter friction with the Windshapers and the looming menace of a local cult.
